---
title: "5. How much of the valley is close to the river?"
---

```{r}
library(terra)

rem <- rast("data/processed/rem_2020_1m.tif")
bands <- classify(rem, rcl = c(-Inf, 0, 1, 2, 3, Inf))

f <- freq(bands)
f$area_km2 <- round(f$count / 1e6, 2)
f$pct <- round(100 * f$count / sum(f$count), 1)
f$cumulative_km2 <- cumsum(f$area_km2)
f
```
```{r}
plot(bands, col = c("#08306b", "#fdae61", "#fee08b", "#d9ef8b", "grey85"),
     main = "Height above the river, 2020")
```
```{r}
dtm <- rast("data/processed/dtm_2020_1m.tif")

x <- seq(367800, 370300, by = 5)
ground <- extract(dtm, cbind(x, 196800))[[1]]
water  <- ground - extract(rem, cbind(x, 196800))[[1]]

plot(x, ground, type = "l", ylim = range(c(ground, water), na.rm = TRUE),
     xlab = "Easting (m)", ylab = "Elevation (m, NAVD88)",
     main = "Cross-section at 196,800 N (west to east)")
lines(x, water, col = "steelblue", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
legend("topleft", c("ground (DTM)", "estimated water surface"),
       col = c("black", "steelblue"), lty = c(1, 2), bty = "n")
```
```{r}
library(sf)

cl <- st_read("data/reach/centerlines.geojson", quiet = TRUE) |> st_transform(2856)
corridor <- st_read("data/reach/corridor.geojson", quiet = TRUE) |> st_transform(2856)

ends <- st_buffer(cl, 2000, endCapStyle = "FLAT") |> st_union()
analysis_area <- st_intersection(st_geometry(corridor), ends)
analysis_area <- st_cast(analysis_area, "POLYGON")
analysis_area <- analysis_area[which.max(st_area(analysis_area))]

st_write(st_sf(name = "analysis area", geometry = analysis_area) |> st_transform(4326),
         "data/reach/analysis_area.geojson", delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

rem <- mask(rem, vect(analysis_area))
bands <- classify(rem, rcl = c(-Inf, 0, 1, 2, 3, Inf))

f <- freq(bands)
f$area_km2 <- round(f$count / 1e6, 2)
f$pct <- round(100 * f$count / sum(f$count), 1)
f$cumulative_km2 <- cumsum(f$area_km2)
f
```
```{r}
library(tmap)

area <- vect("data/reach/analysis_area.geojson") |> project("EPSG:2856")
dtm <- rast("data/processed/dtm_2020_1m.tif") |> mask(area)

dtm3 <- aggregate(dtm, 3)
rem3 <- aggregate(rem, 3) |> clamp(lower = 0, upper = 8, values = TRUE)
hs <- shade(terrain(dtm3, "slope", unit = "radians"),
            terrain(dtm3, "aspect", unit = "radians"),
            angle = 45, direction = 315)

m <- tm_shape(hs) +
  tm_raster(col.scale = tm_scale_continuous(values = "-brewer.greys"),
            col.legend = tm_legend_hide()) +
  tm_shape(rem3) +
  tm_raster(col.scale = tm_scale_continuous(values = "brewer.yl_gn_bu", limits = c(0, 8)),
            col_alpha = 0.7,
            col.legend = tm_legend(title = "Height above river (m)")) +
  tm_shape(cl) + tm_lines(col = "white", lwd = 1) +
  tm_scalebar(position = c("left", "bottom")) +
  tm_compass(position = c("right", "top")) +
  tm_title("Puyallup and Carbon Rivers near Orting, WA")

dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
tmap_save(m, "figures/rem_map.png", width = 7, height = 9, dpi = 200)
m
```
